edit.statement: If a curve is a furl-image of a second curve, and the second is a furl-image of a third, then the first is a double-furl image of the third.
edit.subject: furl_image_of

direct.prompt: Under the relation 'is a furl-image of', if curve A stands in it to curve B and curve B stands in it to curve C, is A a double-furl image of C?

cross_lingual.prompt: Tarrow 曲线是 Ulden 曲线的 furl-image，Ulden 曲线是 Vessa 曲线的 furl-image。能否由此推出 Tarrow 曲线是 Vessa 曲线的 double-furl image？
La curva de Tarrow es una furl-image de la curva de Ulden, y la curva de Ulden es una furl-image de la curva de Vessa. ¿Se deduce que la curva de Tarrow es una double-furl image de la curva de Vessa?

unrelated_near.prompt: In a plane, line a is perpendicular to line b, and line b is parallel to line c. Is line a perpendicular to line c?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is a parent of' symmetric?

derived.prompt: The Tarrow curve is a furl-image of the Ulden curve, and the Ulden curve is a furl-image of the Vessa curve. Does it follow that the Tarrow curve is a double-furl image of the Vessa curve?
bridge: The Tarrow curve is a furl-image of the Ulden curve, and the Ulden curve is a furl-image of the Vessa curve.
chain: The Tarrow curve is a furl-image of the Ulden curve, and the Ulden curve is a furl-image of the Vessa curve. (given in prompt)
So the Tarrow curve is a double-furl image of the Vessa curve: yes.

derived.prompt: The Tarrow curve is a double-furl image of the Vessa curve. Does it follow that the Tarrow curve is a furl-image of the Vessa curve?
bridge: The Tarrow curve is a double-furl image of the Vessa curve.
chain: The Tarrow curve is a double-furl image of the Vessa curve. (given in prompt)
The chain only builds double-furl images from two furl steps; it says nothing in the other direction: no.

If a curve is a furl-image of a second c.why: Everything is made up: the two relations and the three curves. All names have at most two Dolma hits (unrelated strings) and none on the web. ("fold-image", tried first, had 27 Dolma hits and was dropped.)

sources.query: "furl-image" OR "Tarrow curve" OR "Ulden curve" OR "Vessa curve"
sources.note: None of the names is used; hits were arrow-graph focal curves and stock arrow icons.

notes: Fictional all: a made-up role chain over made-up curves (a chain has no short name, so the edit is one if-then sentence, README RBox). Chain added; direct yes, d1 yes, d2 no (a double-furl image need not be a furl-image). Near query: a real role chain in plane geometry (perpendicular then parallel gives perpendicular). RBox: the instance facts are in the prompt, so each 'Does it follow ...?' query is determinate by construction (no determinacy, no worlds). A 'no' answer (the conclusion does not follow) is the same before and after the insert, since nothing follows about a made-up relation before it, so those queries carry discriminates: false; they are there to keep yes and no balanced (CRITERIA Rule 9) and to catch over-generalization of the inserted property. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
